mechanismContracts.claim: fI increments generation, stores native registration result, and guards callback by suspension counter, registered state and generation.

aI preserves ownership wrappers, Windows/bare-modifier branches, normalized duplicate rejection, registration failure, release-monitor rollback, suspension and unregister cleanup. Native/helper providers remain external.
pI retains macOS layout re-registration behavior: suspended entries update their key; failed replacement restores old key/generation/registered state; success unregisters the old key.

Pw is a React effect adapter: enabled/active/priority, keyboard/context handlers, shared registry and menu metadata updates, with cleanup. Preserve it separately from native global shortcuts and message subscriptions.
